question: A junior administrator attempts to use the mobile application to access the CI Class Manager to quickly verify a class definition while on-site. Why does this action fail?

choices.text: CI Class Manager is only available through the Service Portal.
CMDB features, including the CI Class Manager, are not supported on mobile devices.
The administrator must first use the CMDB Query Builder to enable mobile access for classes.

explanation: The source documentation explicitly states that CMDB modules, features, and wizards—specifically including the CI Class Manager—are not supported on mobile devices.
pieges: Thinking it is a permissions issue (role-based) rather than a platform limitation.
Assuming modern ServiceNow mobile apps support all desktop modules.
